entity_identifiers: primary registry id (NCT, ChiCTR, CTRI, jRCT, ...)
historical_coverage: indexes 17+ primary registries; coverage depends on registry
known_limitations: no public machine API: both probed URLs returned HTML forms, which are not queryable records
the portal's ASP.NET viewstate cannot be driven reliably without a browser, and scraping it is out of scope
the primary registries it indexes (CT.gov, CTIS, ChiCTR, CTRI, jRCT) should be collected directly instead
licence: WHO portal terms; the trial data itself belong to the primary registries
rate_limits: no API exists; the search portal is an ASP.NET form
research_value: Documents the global trial-registry landscape, but contributes no collectable evidence; used here as the pointer to the primary registries rather than as a data source.
source_name: WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform
